library_summary_es: La evidencia depende mucho de la preparación, dosis, población y objetivo; no debe extrapolarse entre extractos diferentes.
review_requirements: Indication-specific human evidence and clinical effect size
Population, comparison, studied chemical form, dose and duration
Adverse effects, contraindications, interactions with medications and other supplements
Cumulative intake and duplicate ingredient forms
Special populations and missing safety answers
Evidence sources with dates and review sign-off
note: Research intake is not clinical approval.
